summary: Check Point Quantum Spark firewalls with the most complete SNBT subscription: everything in NGTP plus a sandbox for unknown files and gateway phishing blocking.
value: Unknown malicious files are stopped in the sandbox before they reach a computer.
Fresh phishing sites are blocked at the gateway, with no agents on computers.
Known attacks, malicious sites and botnet traffic are blocked at the edge.
simple: Check Point’s line of next-generation firewalls for small and mid-sized businesses and branch offices (models from desktop to 1U, with Wi-Fi 7 and 5G). Every device has a firewall with user control, VPN between offices and for remote employees, QoS, protection for IoT devices (cameras, VoIP, printers) and SD-WAN for a backup link; management through a web interface, the cloud-based Spark Management for MSPs, or Smart-1. With the SNBT (SandBlast) subscription — the most complete protection: application control, IPS, website filtering, antivirus, Anti-Bot, antispam, plus the SandBlast Threat Emulation sandbox for unknown files and Zero Phishing — blocking phishing sites on the gateway, without agents. The subscription works on any model in the line; in the first year the device ships with SNBT, after which you can renew NGFW, NGTP or SNBT.
classification: Threat Emulation is the sandbox class; gateway Zero Phishing is browser protection (the class description now covers “in the browser or at the gateway”).
